mechanism_narrative: Rising consumer demand proxied by HOUST coincides with stronger labor market conditions (PAYEMS) and leads to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero when controlling for inflation (F-stat < 1.96).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4% triggers a risk-off cascade that depresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive despite the rate hike signal (p-value > 0.05 in a t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained uptick in unemployment benefits claims (PAYEMS) below 150,000 suggests labor market softening, which precedes a decline in S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p-value > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105 signals supply-side constraints that reduce growth expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are flat with no statistically significant deviation from zero (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in both consumer (HOUST) and business demand (RSAFS) above 1400 and 620,000 respectively creates a dual-demand surge that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative despite both proxies above thresholds (multivariate regression F-stat < 1).

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% indicates labor market tightness that supports equity valuations, producing positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly different from zero (p-value > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 200,000 in a month signals labor market acceleration, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p-value > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 triggers a supply shock that compresses growth expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly different from zero (p-value > 0.05).
